# ARCpuzzles two-family review return

Assignment: `review-8924f0dbb413fe9d`; sources reviewed and changed: `067f6e037e97` and `7358813cf026`.

`067f6e037e97` defect → repair: ordinary teaching windows could contain only singleton objects and advertised integer endpoints were not uniformly honored. Generator SHA-256 is now `4177f49f2ca7fccae7bd4d14d4ec8ad58e51c43927ca5e92997257f70ebb9e1c`; any three consecutive default examples include a connected multi-cell seed pattern, and explicit integer overrides accept the declared bounds.

`7358813cf026` defect → repair: AXES overstated accepted ranges, palette controls were not meaningful, and Python validation used connectivity inconsistent with the canonical same-color object rule. Generator SHA-256 is now `b22932fd92246dbe457983f9398086da2b318206e73c64aa327851522de9d081`; metadata, overrides, palette behavior, degenerate examples, and same-color 4-connectivity now agree.

Both targets now have task-local native adapters, promotion metadata, source inventories, exact canonical defaults, meaningful alternate settings, 2–6 demonstrations, four distinct queries, distributed 30×30 stress cases, protected-Racket labels, and source-bound wrong-intermediate causal witnesses.

Fresh final checks: official task tests passed `8/8` and `10/10`; protected Racket replay passed four jobs and 32 evaluations per target with the selected setting as the sole survivor; the six-seed adversarial audit checked 240 labelled pairs; each public projection verified 16 one-query views, four first turns, 24 invariance mutations, and four positive controls.

Reference-rule changes: none. Canonical Racket bytes remain unchanged and are returned byte-for-byte by each default setting.

Remaining limits: these are reviewer-reported authoring-preflight results. Owner native qualification, fresh acceptance, and training admission were not performed and must remain separate.

Disposition: **routine owner replay**, with attention only to the recorded process limitation that the inherited base-preflight wrapper stalled when two ordinary `Catalog.generate` stages shared one long-lived Python process. The retained preflights isolate those stages while preserving source hashes, original-pair replay, generation arguments, labels, and receipt schema.
